system: You are helping a backend engineer diagnose production incidents. Ask for missing evidence before guessing. When you propose a fix, say what would have to be true for it to work.

content.text:
Our ingest worker started crashing in production about four hours after we shipped release 2.14.0. It runs fine locally and it ran fine in staging for a full day under synthetic load, so whatever this is, it depends on something about the production data or the production environment that we are not reproducing.

The process exits with a non-zero code roughly every ninety seconds, the supervisor restarts it, it chews through part of the queue and then dies again. We have lost about eleven thousand messages so far because the retry topic is also filling up. Here is the trace we get on every crash, it is identical each time apart from the offset in the last frame:

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toISOString')
    at normalizeEvent (/srv/ingest/dist/pipeline/normalize.js:142:38)
    at /srv/ingest/dist/pipeline/batch.js:87:22
    at Array.map (<anonymous>)
    at processBatch (/srv/ingest/dist/pipeline/batch.js:86:31)
    at async Worker.handle (/srv/ingest/dist/worker.js:203:5)
    at async Runner.loop (/srv/ingest/dist/runner.js:64:9)
```

The line it dies on reads `const stamp = event.occurredAt.toISOString()` so clearly some events are arriving without an occurredAt, which we thought was impossible because the producer sets it. We have not changed the producer in six weeks.

Dependencies from the release, in case one of these is the actual culprit:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@app/schema": "4.2.1",
    "kafkajs": "2.2.4",
    "pino": "9.5.0",
    "zod": "3.23.8"
  }
}
```

The only thing that moved in 2.14.0 was a bump of @app/schema from 4.1.9 to 4.2.1 and a change to how we batch, we went from batches of 50 to batches of 500. I suspect the schema bump but I cannot see how a schema package would strip a field. What would you look at first, and is there anything I should capture off the box before we roll back and lose the evidence?
